title: Evolving Together, Failing Apart: The Skill-Policy Co-evolution Trap in Self-Improving Agents
abstract: arXiv:2610.20845v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Skill-policy co-evolution, in which an agent's policy model and its skill bank improve each other during training, is a promising paradigm for self-improving agents. Current evaluations score the co-evolved policy on the final bank it trained with (the delivered bank). After deployment, however, skills may be rewritten, added or removed more frequently than the policy model is retrained, leaving the policy to operate on a drifted skill bank that neither the training objective nor existing evaluation protocols address. In this paper, we first establish, through theoretical and empirical analysis, that the fragility hidden by this blind spot is not incidental. The acceptance rule these methods share (cooperative acceptance) ties a policy's competence to the bank it co-evolved with, leaving it fragile once skills drift, regardless of the implementation; empirically, sensitivity to skill drift grows as co-evolution training proceeds. translated_title: 共同进化，分道崩溃：自改进智能体中的技能-策略协同进化陷阱
translated_abstract: 技能-策略协同进化，即智能体的策略模型与其技能库在训练过程中相互促进提升，是一种有前景的自改进智能体范式。当前的评估方法是用策略模型训练时最终使用的技能库（即交付的技能库）来对协同进化后的策略进行评分。然而，在部署之后，技能被重写、添加或删除的频率可能高于策略模型被重新训练的频率，导致策略不得不在发生漂移的技能库上运行，而这一情形既未被训练目标所覆盖，也未被现有的评估协议所考虑。本文首先通过理论分析和实证分析证明，这一盲点所掩盖的脆弱性并非偶然。这些方法共有的接受规则（合作式接受）将策略的能力与其协同进化的技能库绑定在一起，一旦技能发生漂移，策略就会变得脆弱，且无论具体实现如何均如此；实证结果表明，对技能漂移的敏感性会随着协同进化训练的推进而不断增强。
tldr: 本文揭示了自改进智能体中技能-策略协同进化的固有脆弱性：策略能力与协同进化的技能库深度绑定，部署后技能库漂移会导致策略性能崩溃，且这种脆弱性随训练进行而加剧，现有评估协议无法发现这一问题。
en_tdlr: This paper reveals an inherent fragility in skill-policy co-evolution for self-improving agents: the policy's competence is tied to the skill bank it co-evolved with, making it collapse under skill drift after deployment, with sensitivity growing as training proceeds—a blind spot unaddressed by existing evaluation protocols.
